title: PipeshubToolCallPresentedEvent
description: How a tool call is shown: the arguments as the legacy stream rendered them, a summary and a display name. Presentation only (non-critical); the fold ignores it.

argsJson.description: The call's arguments serialized for the live TOOL_CALL_ARGS frame.

args.description: The size-bounded serialization (serialize_tool_args) when it differs from argsJson: the live TOOL_CALL_ARGS frame's argsPreview, and parts[] args unless savedArgs is given.

savedArgs.description: The arguments as parts[] keep them, when that differs from args (or argsJson): this request's citation refs stored as the URLs they stand for, before the size bound (legacy's saved tool part).

hidden.description: An internal tool the stream never shows (no frames, no part).

streamsAnswer.description: The call's arguments stream as the answer (final_answer), not as a tool call.

step.description: Which page, query, pattern or file the step used (WP-115): the loop's steps carry the facts an engine's do.
